CLASS IDENTITY IS THE CARTRIDGE'S, NOT A COINED ONE. _ZTS at ov012:0x021123d0 spells "14daObjC0Water_c"; _ZTI at 0x021123c4 is an __si_class_type_info whose +8 word points at _ZTI10dBgActor_c (ov002:0x021089ec), so the direct base is dBgActor_c and nothing else; _ZTV at 0x02112408 is the address point, with a zero offset-to-top and &_ZTI in the two words below it at 0x02112400. The former coined BasementWater spelling has been removed from config/arm9/overlays/ov012/symbols.txt (it duplicated _ZTV14daObjC0Water_c on the same word) and renamed out of the tree with tools/class_rename.py. Do not move the _ZTV address.
Promoted filename uses the snake_case scheme in notes/tu-naming-and-swallowers.md sec 1 (tools/tu_names.py): daObjC0Water_c -> d_a_obj_c0_water.

THE DESTRUCTOR IS DECLARED FIRST AND INLINE. The inline definition is not the key function: this TU defines all six of the class's virtuals, mwccarm homes _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS here, and the records are licensed below. Declaring it out of line instead makes mwccarm emit D0 ahead of D1 -- the cartridge has D1 first at 0x02111450 -- which objisolate refuses with `requested functions are not emitted in ROM order`, and adds an unhomed D2 the ROM never carried.

Reconstructed source-style factory symbol daObjC0Water_c_classInit: class identity is ROM-proven by RTTI/allocation/vtable and profile identity by the literal ROM ID C0_WATER; the classInit spelling is later-EAD lineage reconstruction. Historical alias: BasementWater_Spawn. This class's own members take no parameters. Sound::PlayLong and Sound::PlaySecretSound are reached through include/Sound.h rather than a hand-spelled mangled seam (#2727); PlayLong's ROM mangle encodes RK7Vector3 (const Vector3 &), and a pointer argument is byte-identical, so this caller alone does not settle the reference spelling -- the header's definition-side reading does.

LEFTOVER CLEANUP. classInit is `return new daObjC0Water_c()` via fBase_c::operator new(unsigned long). `virtual ~daObjC0Water_c() {}` is inline and first in the class, so mwccarm emits the retail D1-then-D0 pair and no leaf D2; InitResources is the key function and still homes _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS here (deadstrip-data). The inline chain also emits a homeless `_ZN10dBgActor_cD2Ev`, licensed deadstrip below. g_profile_C0_WATER stays outside this TU (S14).
